caribbean.headline: Caribbean Storms Bring Rain
caribbean.paragraph: St. Lucia is experiencing 75% rain probability with winds of 11 kt and wave heights of 5.4 ft, while Roatan is seeing winds of 24 kt. I expect the Lesser Antilles to bear the brunt of this system, with St. Lucia being the top impact port due to the high rain probability and moderate sea conditions.

mediterranean.headline: Mediterranean Conditions: Mykonos
mediterranean.paragraph: Mykonos in the Eastern Mediterranean is the highest-impact location in the Mediterranean this period, with winds peaking at 25 kt and seas building to 6.9 ft with ENE swell at 6s periods. less than 10% rain probability -- overall conditions are favorable for cruise operations.
